caseNameFull: Mrs. William F. Hardin, in Error v. Cottonwood Lumber Company
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the .State of Arkansas.
attorneys: Mr. John W. Blackwood for plaintiff* in error. Mr. John B. Jones and Mr. William L. Terry for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam. Mr. John W. Blackwood for plaintiff* in error. Mr. John B. Jones and Mr. William L. Terry for defendant in error.

Judgment affirmed with costs. Soper v. Lawrence Bros., 201 U. S. 359; Turner v. New York, 168 U. S. 90; Lumber Company v. Hardin, 78 Arkansas, 95; Towson v. Denson, 74 Arkanas, 302.
